campaign: Living Your Legacy — Meta Podcast Growth (refreshed clip set)
compliance_notes: Real podcast footage + branded end card. No advice/performance claims. Steelers branding NOT used. SEC disclaimer in footer.

ads.title: The Power of Saying Yes
ads.primary_text:
What would your life look like if you had said yes to the thing that frightened you?

Betsy Wentz said yes to all of it. The founder of Betsy Wentz Interior Design and author of Design Happy left a career in behavioral health for a studio of her own, and the advice she now gives her children comes from everything that followed.

Living Your Legacy with Greg Weimer. New episodes on YouTube.
ads.headline: Living Your Legacy with Greg Weimer

ads.title: Finding Joy In the Journey
ads.primary_text:
Why would a player call a last-place season the time of his life?

Ryan Malone, retired NHL player and founder of the Malone Family Foundation, grew up in St. Clair and became the first Pittsburgh-raised player to reach the league. Twelve years in, he measured a good season by something that never showed up in the standings.

Living Your Legacy with Greg Weimer. New episodes on YouTube.
ads.headline: Living Your Legacy with Greg Weimer
ads.guest_title: Retired NHL Player, Malone Family Foundation

ads.title: Sarris Candies Story
ads.primary_text:
How does a disappointing box of chocolates become a Pittsburgh institution?

Bill Sarris traces Sarris Candies back to a gift his father brought his mother. His father was embarrassed by it, decided he could do better, and went down to the basement to start making candy himself.

Living Your Legacy with Greg Weimer. New episodes on YouTube.
ads.headline: Living Your Legacy with Greg Weimer

ads.title: Lessons Learned from Jerome Bettis
ads.primary_text:
What does character look like on an early morning flight?

Beth Vietmeier of The Jerome Bettis Bus Stops Here Foundation has traveled the world alongside Jerome Bettis and has never once seen him turn down a stranger who asked for a photo. His reason is the part she carried into how she leads.

Living Your Legacy with Greg Weimer. New episodes on YouTube.
ads.headline: Living Your Legacy with Greg Weimer
ads.guest_title: The Jerome Bettis Bus Stops Here Foundation

ads.title: Start with Your Why
ads.primary_text:
What happens to the person who is never quite intentional about anything?

Andrew DiDonato took over a Grove City College football program that had not won a game in three years. The head coach answers that question with one phrase he repeats to his players, and the reason it works has very little to do with football.

Living Your Legacy with Greg Weimer. New episodes on YouTube.
ads.headline: Living Your Legacy with Greg Weimer
ads.guest_title: Head Football Coach, Grove City College

ads.title: The Joy of Missing Out
ads.primary_text:
Why would someone give a TED Talk about everything they were getting wrong?

Sabrina Saunders Mosby, President and Chief Executive Officer of Vibrant Pittsburgh, was building a business with an infant at home while telling everyone it was possible to have it all. She was breaking down behind it, and she named the talk after what she found on the other side.

Living Your Legacy with Greg Weimer. New episodes on YouTube.
ads.headline: Living Your Legacy with Greg Weimer
ads.guest_title: President and Chief Executive Officer, Vibrant Pittsburgh

ads.title: Every Experience Matters
ads.primary_text:
If you were handed one do-over, what would you use it on?

Yianni Bourbakis, co-owner of Elia Mediterranean Grille, was asked exactly that. His one-word answer says more about how he built the place than any story about the food could.

Living Your Legacy with Greg Weimer. New episodes on YouTube.
ads.headline: Living Your Legacy with Greg Weimer

ads.title: A Home With Soul
ads.primary_text:
Why do so many beautiful houses feel like nobody lives in them?

Betsy Wentz, founder of Betsy Wentz Interior Design, refuses to finish a home without dragging its owner into her studio first. What she is looking for there has very little to do with taste.

Living Your Legacy with Greg Weimer. New episodes on YouTube.
ads.headline: Living Your Legacy with Greg Weimer

ads.title: What My Son Taught Me
ads.primary_text:
What would change if you saw an ordinary day through someone else's eyes?

Jason Esch, who runs TeamLogic IT Pittsburgh, calls his oldest son the gift that keeps on giving. What that son has taught him about patience and presence has reshaped the whole family.

Living Your Legacy with Greg Weimer. New episodes on YouTube.
ads.headline: Living Your Legacy with Greg Weimer
ads.guest_title: President and Owner, TeamLogic IT Pittsburgh

ads.title: Leadership Gaps in the Next Generation
ads.primary_text:
What is the one leadership skill nobody can fake?

Jason Esch, who runs TeamLogic IT Pittsburgh, believes the next generation will lead on relationships. He also names the thing that makes that work, and it is the part most leaders would rather skip.

Living Your Legacy with Greg Weimer. New episodes on YouTube.
ads.headline: Living Your Legacy with Greg Weimer
ads.guest_title: President and Owner, TeamLogic IT Pittsburgh

ads.title: A Career of Continuous Learning
ads.primary_text:
When did you last take a pay cut and feel lucky about it?

Ezra Shapiro left an office job for twelve dollars an hour in a kitchen and went home every night thinking about it. The private chef explains what he saw in that room that made the math stop mattering.

Living Your Legacy with Greg Weimer. New episodes on YouTube.
ads.headline: Living Your Legacy with Greg Weimer

ads.title: Creating Meaningful Change
ads.primary_text:
What part of your work would you keep if you had to give up the rest?

Beth Vietmeier, founder of Valiant 3 Communications, runs the marketing and the events and genuinely loves both. Ask her what she would keep and she names something else entirely.

Living Your Legacy with Greg Weimer. New episodes on YouTube.
ads.headline: Living Your Legacy with Greg Weimer

ads.title: What Truly Fills Her Cup
ads.primary_text:
What does a hospital fundraiser love most about the job?

Rachel Petrucelli, President of the UPMC Children's Hospital Foundation, gave an answer that surprised the person asking her. It reframes what giving actually is, and who it changes.

Living Your Legacy with Greg Weimer. New episodes on YouTube.
ads.headline: Living Your Legacy with Greg Weimer

ads.title: Falling in Love With the Process
ads.primary_text:
What happens the first time you genuinely put in the work?

Chris Lee, managing director of the Pittsburgh law firm Dickie McCamey, says he had never done it before law school. He describes the season that changed and what it did to his confidence.

Living Your Legacy with Greg Weimer. New episodes on YouTube.
ads.headline: Living Your Legacy with Greg Weimer
ads.guest_title: Managing Director and COO, Dickie McCamey

ads.title: Learning Through Reading
ads.primary_text:
What would you tell someone who wants to be excellent at anything?

Private chef Ezra Shapiro answers in two words and means them literally. He taught himself the business side of kitchens the same way, long before anyone paid him to run one.

Living Your Legacy with Greg Weimer. New episodes on YouTube.
ads.headline: Living Your Legacy with Greg Weimer

ads.title: Proactive, Not Reactive
ads.primary_text:
How much of your doctor's attention do seven minutes actually buy?

Dr. Sunjay Mannan, founder of Health Is Wealth Concierge Medicine, sits at his patients' kitchen tables for two hours instead. He explains what turns up in the other hour and fifty-three minutes.

Living Your Legacy with Greg Weimer. New episodes on YouTube.
ads.headline: Living Your Legacy with Greg Weimer
ads.guest_title: Founder, Health Is Wealth Concierge Medicine

ads.title: How He Handles Stress
ads.primary_text:
Does your doctor follow the advice he gives you?

Dr. Sunjay Mannan, founder of Health Is Wealth Concierge Medicine, handles his own stress with the protocol he hands his patients. He walks through what that looks like in an ordinary week.

Living Your Legacy with Greg Weimer. New episodes on YouTube.
ads.headline: Living Your Legacy with Greg Weimer
ads.guest_title: Founder, Health Is Wealth Concierge Medicine

ads.title: Modeling Self-Care
ads.primary_text:
What is your child learning from watching how you work?

Dr. Sunjay Mannan, founder of Health Is Wealth Concierge Medicine, has brought his daughter along on patient visits so she can see it for herself. What he wants her to take from it is not about medicine.

Living Your Legacy with Greg Weimer. New episodes on YouTube.
ads.headline: Living Your Legacy with Greg Weimer
ads.guest_title: Founder, Health Is Wealth Concierge Medicine

ads.title: Not Just Dinner
ads.primary_text:
What turns a dinner into the thing people still talk about a year later?

Ezra Shapiro cooks private events in other people's homes, for four guests or for twenty. The private chef explains how he builds an entire menu around one person at the table.

Living Your Legacy with Greg Weimer. New episodes on YouTube.
ads.headline: Living Your Legacy with Greg Weimer

ads.title: The Mindset
ads.primary_text:
What do you call it when you can see something that is not there yet?

Yianni Bourbakis is co-owner of Elia Mediterranean Grille, named for the Greek word for olive and the tree his country gathers under. He has one ingredient he tells his chefs matters more than any other.

Living Your Legacy with Greg Weimer. New episodes on YouTube.
ads.headline: Living Your Legacy with Greg Weimer

ads.title: They Sold a Ring to Start
ads.primary_text:
What would you sell to bet on yourselves?

Lou and Veronica Guarino sold her wedding ring for ten thousand dollars to start Louis Anthony Jewelers. A client had been asking to buy that ring for years.

Living Your Legacy with Greg Weimer. New episodes on YouTube.
ads.headline: Living Your Legacy with Greg Weimer

ads.title: Make People Feel at Home
ads.primary_text:
What can a jeweler learn from a hospital president picking up litter?

Lou and Veronica Guarino of Louis Anthony Jewelers watched it happen and never forgot the line that came with it. It is now how they want every person who walks through their door to feel.

Living Your Legacy with Greg Weimer. New episodes on YouTube.
ads.headline: Living Your Legacy with Greg Weimer

ads.title: First to the NHL
ads.primary_text:
What does it take to be the first person from your neighborhood to do something?

Ryan Malone, retired NHL player and founder of the Malone Family Foundation, grew up in St. Clair and became the first Pittsburgh-raised player to reach the league. He is candid about whether he ever believed it was possible.

Living Your Legacy with Greg Weimer. New episodes on YouTube.
ads.headline: Living Your Legacy with Greg Weimer

ads.title: A Harder Chapter
ads.primary_text:
The hardest thing he ever did happened nowhere near a rink. What was it?

Ryan Malone, retired NHL player and founder of the Malone Family Foundation, talks openly about the night he checked himself in and asked for help. Greg calls it braver than anything he did in the NHL.

Living Your Legacy with Greg Weimer. New episodes on YouTube.
ads.headline: Living Your Legacy with Greg Weimer

ads.title: It Takes a Team
ads.primary_text:
What is the one piece of advice a Pittsburgh institution gives a new business owner?

Bill Sarris of Sarris Candies names the thing that has to happen before a business can grow past the person who started it. He calls it the hardest question anyone can ask him.

Living Your Legacy with Greg Weimer. New episodes on YouTube.
ads.headline: Living Your Legacy with Greg Weimer

ads.title: The Margin of Excellence
ads.primary_text:
What does a donation to a children's hospital actually pay for?

Rachel Petrucelli, President of the UPMC Children's Hospital Foundation, calls philanthropy the margin of excellence. She explains what that buys, and why it can decide whether a family has to leave Pittsburgh to get their child care.

Living Your Legacy with Greg Weimer. New episodes on YouTube.
ads.headline: Living Your Legacy with Greg Weimer

ads.title: Treat People the Right Way
ads.primary_text:
How should a law firm treat the people on the other side of the case?

Chris Lee, managing director of Dickie McCamey, holds his firm to one standard with opposing counsel, its partners and its own staff alike. He explains what that has built for them in court.

Living Your Legacy with Greg Weimer. New episodes on YouTube.
ads.headline: Living Your Legacy with Greg Weimer
ads.guest_title: Managing Director and COO, Dickie McCamey

ads.title: The Case That Defined a Career
ads.primary_text:
What happens to a lawyer who takes on the largest outbreak in the country?

Chris Lee of Dickie McCamey got the Chi-Chi's hepatitis A case in 2003, with a thousand people affected and the FDA, the CDC and the national news arriving at once. It shaped how he has practiced ever since.

Living Your Legacy with Greg Weimer. New episodes on YouTube.
ads.headline: Living Your Legacy with Greg Weimer
ads.guest_title: Managing Director and COO, Dickie McCamey

ads.title: Why I Built Mileage
ads.primary_text:
Should you master one thing, or try everything first?

Bill Bishilany, founder of Mileage Design, built his company on the answer most career advice argues against. He traces it back to what human-centered design taught him about solving hard problems.

Living Your Legacy with Greg Weimer. New episodes on YouTube.
ads.headline: Living Your Legacy with Greg Weimer

ads.title: The Other Side of Hard
ads.primary_text:
What if everything you want is not on the other side of hard?

Bill Bishilany, founder of Mileage Design, had that slogan framed in his office until the day he rewrote it. The word he put in its place changed how he runs the company.

Living Your Legacy with Greg Weimer. New episodes on YouTube.
ads.headline: Living Your Legacy with Greg Weimer

ads.title: The Mosaic
ads.primary_text:
Why does good marketing so often fail on one missing piece?

Bill Bishilany, founder of Mileage Design, describes the work as a mosaic of tiles and names them one at a time. Miss a single tile and the picture never quite resolves.

Living Your Legacy with Greg Weimer. New episodes on YouTube.
ads.headline: Living Your Legacy with Greg Weimer
